comment: Service user accounts for Tier Model. Rarely changes after initial deployment.

users.description: This account has the rights to domain join to the PAW Staging OU
users.comment: Used for automated provision of PAW devices into the Tier Model staging OU for domain join, else leave disabled
users.info:
=======================================================
TIER MODEL IDENTITY DOCUMENTATION
=======================================================
SCOPE      : Tier 0 (Control Plane)
ROLE       : PAW Provisioning Service Account
PRIVILEGES : Delegated rights to join PAW computer
             objects into Tier 0 PAW Staging OU.
             Disabled by default.
-------------------------------------------------------
CHANGE & AUDIT TRACKING:
- Version  : TierModel v2.0 (Microsoft EAM)
- Managed  : AD Security Architecture Team

=======================================================

users.description: Emergency break-fix account. Used ONLY when Tier 0 Admins or AuthSilo services are unavailable.
users.comment: Emergency break-fix account (Break Glass). Excluded from AuthSilo & Protected Users for disaster recovery.
users.info:
